decisions.reason: As a recent launch in an adjacent drainage segment, the firm is likely to continue it for now, though the lighter website commitment suggests somewhat less escalation pressure than for flagship launches.
Because it received its own product page at launch, management has made a visible public commitment and is likely to persist with the product absent clear evidence of failure.

The firm has already invested in this technically distinct drainage solution and will tend to give it more time, but its lower promotional prominence makes withdrawal somewhat more conceivable than for the prominently featured products.
A dedicated page indicates a strong visible commitment, and an established German metal-products firm would usually continue such a closely related product line at least through the next year.
Its own page and fit with the firm's fabricated metal design-drain offering make continued support more likely, with only a modest chance of rationalization in the near term.
